title:
A modern interface
for your FreshRSS
lead: FriRSS connects to your FreshRSS server and reshapes how you read: three layouts, six themes, ten languages, and your articles offline on your phone.
heroLabel: FriRSS with its sidebar of feeds, folders and tags beside the list of today’s articles.

layouts.title: Three layouts, plus full screen
layouts.text: Read next to the list in three columns, sort quickly in two, leaf through pictures in the grid, or give one article the whole screen. Each feed keeps its own layout.
layouts.label: Choose a layout

alt.columns: FriRSS in three columns: feeds, list of articles and the open article side by side.
alt.list: FriRSS in two columns: feeds and a wide list of articles with their summaries.
alt.grid: FriRSS in a grid: articles as cards under the feeds sidebar.
alt.focus: FriRSS in focus mode: one article across the whole window.

mobile.title: Your articles, even without a network
mobile.text: Install FriRSS on your home screen like an app. Move between articles with a swipe, and prepare the last 30 days for offline reading, images included.
mobile.listAlt: FriRSS on a phone: today’s list of articles.
mobile.articleAlt: FriRSS on a phone: an open article with its reading toolbar.

themes.title: Six themes, 38 colours to adjust
themes.text: Start from a built-in theme, then tune colours, text sizes and spacing. Save the result, export it and share it.
themes.label: Try a theme
themes.alt: FriRSS with the selected theme applied to the sidebar and the open article.

features.title: What FriRSS adds to FreshRSS.
features.subtitle: Read, sort and find things faster.

items.title: Fetches the full article
items.text: When a feed only sends an excerpt, Readability retrieves the whole text. You set it per feed.

items.title: Runs from the keyboard
items.text: ⌘K or Ctrl+K opens feeds, tags and actions. Every shortcut can be changed.

items.title: Files with a long press
items.text: Put an article in Favorites or Read later, inside the sub-folders you create.

items.title: Summarises and translates, if you enable it
items.text: AI stays off until an administrator sets it up. A local model with Ollama or LM Studio works too.

more.title: And everything else
more.note: The four cards above show a few of them in detail.

freshrss.title: Works with your FreshRSS server
freshrss.text: FreshRSS fetches and stores your feeds. FriRSS connects through its Google Reader API and takes care of reading, on every screen.
steps: Start the container with Docker, Compose or Unraid.
Connect your FreshRSS server with its API password.

faqOther: Another question? Ask it in the GitHub discussions.

close.title: Your FriRSS, your rules.
close.text: Try the online demo, then install FriRSS at home. Free, open source, no subscription.

compare.note: FriRSS is an independent project with no official tie to FreshRSS. FreshRSS and its interface belong to their authors; it is reproduced here for comparison.

custom.text: Change the list density, what each row shows, the buttons of the reading pane and of the bars. A hidden button stays in the command palette. Try it here.

languages.title: In your language, articles included
languages.text: The interface comes in ten languages and follows your browser’s. With AI turned on, FriRSS also translates the whole article, title and body, into any of 28 languages: on demand, or as soon as it opens for the feeds you pick. The source text is one click away.

languages.trAlt: FriRSS’s reading pane with an article from a German feed, shown as source text or translated into English.
